name: Eshan
description: Eshan was a planet in the Eshan system of the Inner Rim Territories where the infamous Droid Gotra caused a gang dispute, resulting in the loss of many innocents. Eshan was also the homeworld of Tayshin Maxa and Moda Maxa.
